details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~165-196 and ~3834-3842 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate skip on `[ai-autofix]` synchronize events and the post-commit retrigger skip on `DID_COMMIT=true && CONFLICT_RESOLVED!=true` together remove every automatic continuation path after an autofix commit, halting the loop after one iteration.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers independently reported that after an autofix commit, the synchronize run is skipped and the fallback dispatch is also skipped, leaving only external intervention or the stall cron to resume progress; one reviewer disagreed and treated it as intended, but the highest severity reported is critical.

- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:36 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Changing `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` from `vars.ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS != 'false'` to `contains(' 1 true yes on ', format(' {0} ', vars.ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS || 'true'))` makes the check case-sensitive and breaks existing uppercase truthy values.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed that values like `TRUE`, `Yes`, and `ON` were previously accepted but are no longer matched, silently disabling workflow edits for existing installations.

- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~1791-1815 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `grep -qE '\.codex-workflow-src(-main)?\b'` guard can match the `.codex-workflow-src` submodule pointer and escalate legitimate support-checkout version changes to `ai:needs-human`.
  WHY: Several reviewers identified that the regex is broad enough to catch the submodule pointer file itself, so valid manifest updates can false-positive and hard-fail the implementation path.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~174-179 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The author-email guard is hardcoded to `codex@users.noreply.github.com`, so commits from environments using a different bot noreply address will not be recognized as self-triggered autofix commits.
  WHY: Reviewers flagged this as environment-specific and noted it degrades the skip feature by allowing redundant verification runs rather than recognizing all valid bot authors.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~178-186 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `PR_HEAD_SHA` metadata lookup can fail open when the SHA is empty, malformed, or not yet indexed by GitHub’s API.
  WHY: Reviewers noted this as a reliability edge case that can prevent the skip from activating and increase cost, but it does not create a functional failure.

- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:15-16 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_TIMEOUT_SECS` is passed directly to `timeout` without validation.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed malformed or empty values can make `timeout` fail and stop the consolidation script, making this a robustness issue in the review pipeline.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~164-171 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate relies on `github.event_name` and `github.event.action` propagation in a reusable workflow context, which may not always preserve the original trigger metadata.
  WHY: This was reported as a cost-optimization concern where the skip logic may be bypassed in some reusable-workflow invocations, increasing redundant runs rather than breaking correctness.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~174 (gate job event_name check) | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The gate job’s `github.event_name` / `EVENT_ACTION` check was reported as a potential issue, but the reviewer concluded it works as designed.
  WHY: The reviewer explicitly stated there is no runtime failure here and treated the concern as unfounded.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~3845 (post-commit dispatch skip) | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The post-commit retrigger skip was reported as a possible loop break, but the reviewer concluded it is the intended safety mechanism.
  WHY: The reviewer said the skip prevents infinite loops and does not cause a runtime failure.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~1815 (pathspec hard-fail regex) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The regex `\.codex-workflow-src(-main)?\b` can match `.codex-workflow-src` submodule pointer updates.
  WHY: The reviewer said legitimate submodule pointer edits could be escalated to `ai:needs-human`, though they treated it as an edge case.
- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:36 (ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS expression) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new case-sensitive truthy check breaks backward compatibility for uppercase truthy values.
  WHY: The reviewer called this a clear breaking change for existing installations using uppercase values.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:gate job commit metadata query | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `PR_HEAD_SHA` may be unavailable or unindexed when the gate queries commit metadata.
  WHY: The reviewer said this can cause 404s and incorrect skip decisions on newly created or rapidly pushed branches.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:author email check | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded codex noreply email may not match all environments.
  WHY: The reviewer said valid autofix commits from non-standard bot emails would not be recognized for skipping.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:15-16 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_TIMEOUT_SECS` is used directly in `timeout` without validation.
  WHY: The reviewer said malformed values could make the script fail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:36 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Case-sensitive truthy matching breaks backward compatibility for existing uppercase values.
  WHY: The reviewer said `contains()` is case-sensitive, so existing `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=TRUE` or `Yes` values will stop enabling workflow edits.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Combined skip paths in gate job and post-commit retrigger | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gate skip and post-commit retrigger skip together can halt the autofix loop.
  WHY: The reviewer said both continuation paths are removed after an autofix commit, so the loop stalls until the 30-minute cron or human intervention.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:Line or code reference: `printf '%s' "${remaining_changes}" | grep -qE '\.codex-workflow-src(-main)?\b'` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex can incorrectly match submodule pointer files.
  WHY: The reviewer said legitimate support-submodule updates may trigger the hard-fail guard unnecessarily.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:`timeout "${REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_TIMEOUT_SECS}" ...` | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: An unvalidated environment variable is passed to `timeout`.
  WHY: The reviewer said non-numeric or empty values can make the consolidation script exit non-zero.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Gate job commit metadata query | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `PR_HEAD_SHA` may be stale or not yet indexed when queried.
  WHY: The reviewer said a 404 should be retried or handled fail-open more explicitly to preserve the skip optimization.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:Ancestor-chain no-op cap loop | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The ancestor-chain lookup could be optimized to reduce redundant API calls.
  WHY: The reviewer framed this as a rate-limit/cost hardening suggestion rather than a correctness bug.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Gate job (~174) + Post-commit retrigger (~38,845) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The combined skip logic can halt the autofix loop until the stall cron re-kicks it.
